user.title: Inköp
user.description: Add Inköp, shopping lists on top of the ICA integration.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Inköp is already set up. Only one instance is allowed.
abort.ica_missing: The ICA integration (ha-ica-todo) is not installed. Install version {minimum} or later from https://github.com/per-lennartsson/ha-ica-todo and restart Home Assistant.
abort.ica_too_old: The ICA integration (ha-ica-todo) version {version} is too old. Version {minimum} or later is required. Update it in HACS and restart Home Assistant.
abort.ica_not_configured: The ICA integration (ha-ica-todo) is installed but not set up. Add it under Settings → Devices & services, then try again.
abort.ica_not_loaded: The ICA integration (ha-ica-todo) is set up but not loaded. Check its status under Settings → Devices & services and the logs, then try again.

ica_missing.title: ICA integration is missing
ica_missing.description: Inköp needs the ICA integration (ha-ica-todo) version {minimum} or later, but it is not installed. Install it from https://github.com/per-lennartsson/ha-ica-todo and restart Home Assistant.

ica_too_old.title: ICA integration is too old
ica_too_old.description: Inköp needs the ICA integration (ha-ica-todo) version {minimum} or later, but version {version} is installed. Update it in HACS and restart Home Assistant.

ica_not_configured.title: ICA integration is not set up
ica_not_configured.description: Inköp needs the ICA integration (ha-ica-todo). It is installed but not set up. Add it under Settings → Devices & services.

ica_not_loaded.title: ICA integration is not loaded
ica_not_loaded.description: Inköp needs the ICA integration (ha-ica-todo), which is set up but not loaded. Check its status under Settings → Devices & services and the logs. Inköp retries automatically.

set_active_list.name: Set active list
set_active_list.description: Make an ICA list the household's active shopping list.

entity_id.name: List
entity_id.description: The ICA shopping list to make active.

create_list.name: Create list
create_list.description: Create a new ICA shopping list and wait until it is ready.

title.name: Title
title.description: Name of the list. Defaults to "Att handla <day> <month>".

set_active.name: Make active
set_active.description: Make the new list the active list.

delete_list.name: Delete list
delete_list.description: Permanently delete an ICA shopping list and wait until Home Assistant has updated.

entity_id.name: List
entity_id.description: The ICA shopping list to delete.

add_item.name: Add item
add_item.description: Add an item to a list. If an open item with the same name exists, nothing is added unless confirmed.

entity_id.name: List
entity_id.description: The ICA list. Defaults to the active list.

item.name: Item
item.description: Text such as “2 st gurka” or “mjölk”.

confirm_duplicate.name: Add again
confirm_duplicate.description: Add the item even if it is already on the list.

tick_item.name: Tick item
tick_item.description: Tick (or untick) an item, given its id or text.

entity_id.name: List
entity_id.description: The ICA list. Defaults to the active list.

ticked.name: Ticked
ticked.description: On ticks the item, off unticks it.

remove_item.name: Remove item
remove_item.description: Remove an item, given its id or text.

entity_id.name: List
entity_id.description: The ICA list. Defaults to the active list.

clear_ticked.name: Clear ticked items
clear_ticked.description: Remove all ticked items from a list.

entity_id.name: List
entity_id.description: The ICA list. Defaults to the active list.

get_top_items.name: Get frequent items
get_top_items.description: Return the items added most often, with icons, for quick-add buttons.

suggest_list_name.name: Suggest list name
suggest_list_name.description: Return the default name for a new list, such as “Att handla 14 oktober”.

busy.message: Another list operation is still running. Wait for it to finish.

unknown_list.message: {entity_id} is not a known ICA shopping list.

ica_unavailable.message: The ICA integration (ha-ica-todo) is not loaded. Try again in a moment.

create_timeout.message: The list "{name}" was created, but did not appear in Home Assistant in time. Check the ICA integration.

delete_timeout.message: The list "{name}" was deleted, but Home Assistant did not finish updating in time. Check the ICA integration.

no_list.message: There is no active list. Create a list or choose one first.

list_unavailable.message: The list “{list}” is not available right now (ICA may be reloading). Try again in a moment.

item_not_found.message: No item matching “{item}” on the list.

item_ambiguous.message: More than one item matches “{item}”: {matches}. Use the item id instead.

todo_failed.message: The list {entity_id} could not be updated: {error}

init.title: Notifications
init.description: Choose who is told when someone else adds items. Nobody is told about their own additions.

data_description.users: Leave empty to turn notifications off.

abort.no_users: There are no Home Assistant users to choose from.
abort.no_notify_services: No notify services were found. Set up the Home Assistant companion app on a phone first.
